modifications.zh: 从官方ZIP提取八个原始OBJ；沿用v1固定坐标变换，重算法线，量化并用Meshopt压缩为独立GLB。
modifications.en: Extracted eight original OBJs from the official ZIP; applied the fixed v1 coordinate transform, recomputed normals, quantized and Meshopt-compressed into independent GLBs.
